chunks: So be fearful of God and follow me.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'So be fearful of God and follow me'?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse serves as a divine mandate for the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) to guide his people, establishing a direct link between internal piety (taqwa) and external adherence to prophetic authority. Shia scholarship often views this as a precursor to the concept of Imamate, where obedience to the Prophet extends to his divinely appointed successors, ensuring the continuity of spiritual and temporal guidance.
